post.originalText:
Claude Code running Opus 5.5 got one prompt

"make me a quantum dog. make it go crazy fr"

It collapsed a wavefunction and built one.

Meet the Quantum Dog.

He's a good boy and a bad boy until someone looks.

You just did.

He's in three places at once.

He fetches the ball before you throw it.

He doesn't dig under the fence. He tunnels through it.

You can know where he is or how fast he's running. Never both.

7 hours of generation.
$230 in API credits.
Almost zero manual work.

Would you pet him?
